title: Tom Holland and Zendaya buy £8.25 million London mansion at £750,000 discount
summary_full: Tom Holland and Zendaya have reportedly purchased an £8.25 million mansion in London, paying £750,000 below its asking price. The five-bedroom property spans over 5,000 square feet and sits on an acre of land. The reported cash purchase adds another impressive real estate investment to the couple’s growing property portfolio.
